les: Water hou vir die dag wanneer dit nie reën nie
kaps_punt: Berging van water: Waarom moet mense water stoor; Maniere om water te stoor - soos in damme, watertenke, emmers en potte

items.bewering: Jy het elke dag water nodig, maar die reën val nie elke dag nie.
items.blok: Die reën kom nie wanneer ons wil nie
items.bron: SA's Free Basic Water policy sets a daily minimum of 25 litres per person (Health and Human Rights Journal on the Mazibuko/Phiri case, hhrjournal.org/2009/11/17/south-africas-constitutional-court-makes-final-decision-in-access-to-water-case/; The Conversation, theconversation.com/south-africa-has-failed-to-deliver-access-to-enough-water-for-millions-a-new-approach-is-needed-247831). The DWS describes rainfall as 'highly variable' (Minister Mokonyane, drought media briefing, 1 Nov 2015, dws.gov.za).

items.bewering: Ons kan nie seker weet wanneer of hoeveel dit gaan reën nie.
items.blok: Die reën kom nie wanneer ons wil nie
items.bron: DWS drought briefing, 1 Nov 2015: 'South Africa is a water scarce country with highly variable rainfall and water runoff' and early spring 'has not yielded the anticipated rainfall'. A DWS spokesperson (IOL, 20 May 2025) says the department 'cannot manage the unpredicted weather'.

items.bewering: Soms gaan weke of selfs maande verby sonder genoeg reën.
items.blok: Die reën kom nie wanneer ons wil nie
items.bron: DWS drought briefing, 1 Nov 2015: 'prolonged lower-than-normal rainfall since the beginning of the year'. DWS via IOL, 20 May 2025: Western Cape winter rain 'is then stored for use during the drier spring and summer months'.

items.bewering: Tydens 'n droogte raak water op baie plekke skaars.
items.blok: Die reën kom nie wanneer ons wil nie
items.bron: DWS drought briefing, 1 Nov 2015: drought 'has led to water shortage in a number of public water supply schemes/dams', and 'an estimated 6500 stand-alone rural communities are currently experiencing water shortages'.

items.bewering: Daarom moet boere en dorpe vooruit beplan en water vir later hou.
items.blok: Die reën kom nie wanneer ons wil nie
items.bron: DWS drought briefing, 1 Nov 2015: large schemes have 'a higher assurance of supply due to multi-year water storage', and schemes with less storage capacity 'are more vulnerable to the effect of droughts'. NPR, 4 Feb 2018: an irrigation board sets farmers' quotas according to what the dam can spare.

items.bewering: Om water op te gaar beteken om dit te stoor sodat dit gebruik kan word wanneer dit nodig is.
items.bron: No Afrikaans dictionary entry could be reached: WAT online needs a login, DSAE has no entry, and Wiktionary returned nothing. The Dutch source word 'opgaren' is glossed as 'vergaren, verzamelen, bijeenbrengen, sparen' (gather, collect, bring together, save up; woorden.org/woord/opgaren, citing Encyclo.nl). The lesson's sense of storing so it can be used later is the 'sparen' sense. Accepted on that cognate source, with this caveat noted.

items.bewering: Dan is daar water in die weke waarin niks bykom nie.
items.bron: DWS via IOL, 20 May 2025: rain stored in winter is used in the drier months that follow. DWS 2015: multi-year storage gives a higher assurance of supply.

items.bewering: Boere gaar water op om hul gewasse nat te lei en hul diere altyd water te gee.
items.bron: Metz Dam (Limpopo) serves domestic supply, stock watering and irrigation (Wikipedia, Metz Dam, from the DWS dam register). Injaka Dam's primary purpose is storing water for irrigation. IntechOpen chapter on southern African farm dams (intechopen.com/chapters/88760): small farm dams serve irrigation and livestock watering. 'altyd' expresses the purpose of storage, not a guarantee, and is read that way.

items.bewering: Dorpe en stede stoor water sodat hul mense elke dag water het.
items.bron: Theewaterskloof Dam serves mainly municipal and industrial use as well as irrigation (Wikipedia, Theewaterskloof Dam). Engineering News, 1 Aug 2025: dams built by DWS and municipalities supply water for domestic use, among others.

items.bewering: Damme vang reënwater en rivierwater op en stoor dit agter 'n sterk damwal.
items.bron: Dictionary of South African English, 'dam': 'a man-made pond or reservoir where rain- or springwater is collected for storage'. Its usage note: in SA the wall is called 'the dam wall' (dsae.co.za/entry/dam/e01904). Theewaterskloof Dam impounds the Sonderend River behind a 35 m wall (Wikipedia, Theewaterskloof Dam).

items.bewering: So stoor 'n dam baie water vir dorpe, stede en plase.
items.bron: Theewaterskloof reservoir holds about 480 000 megalitres for municipal, industrial and irrigation use (Wikipedia). NPR, 4 Feb 2018: a network of dams is shared by 'farmers, villages and the City of Cape Town'.

items.bewering: By baie huise en skole loop reënwater van die dak af deur 'n geut en 'n pyp tot in 'n watertenk.
items.bron: City of Cape Town, 'Opvang van reënwater' (Alternatiewe waterhulpbronne, pamphlet 4 of 4): 'As gevolg van swaartekrag loop reënwater wat op jou dak versamel, via geutpype na watertenke.' DWS summit presentation on rainwater harvesting, 18 Feb 2022: a school example with two 5 m3 tanks per school. A Wits study counted about 45 000 tanks in 2017.

items.bewering: Mense gebruik die water later vir die tuin en vir skoonmaak.
items.bron: City of Cape Town, 'Opvang van reënwater': ''n Reënwatertenk kan gebruik word om die tuin te besproei, op te was, skoon te maak, die toilet te spoel...'. The lesson's two uses are both named there, and the lesson does not say they are the only uses.

items.bewering: In sommige huise is daar nie lopende water of 'n watertenk nie.
items.bron: Census 2022, as reported by the Cape Argus (11 Oct 2023) and Africa Check: 8.7% of households had no access to piped water, and a further 8.9% used a community stand or a tap outside the yard.

items.bewering: Daar stoor mense water in emmers, potte en ander groot houers. Die water staan dan gereed wanneer die gesin wil kook, drink of was.
items.bron: Wright et al., Annals of Global Health 2023 (ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC10668882/): about half of the households in four low-income Cape Town settlements stored water in household containers. Mgquba village, Eastern Cape (AQUA 2003): borehole water stored in household containers. Water SA vol. 35 no. 4: storage containers for drinking water in rural households. The sources name plastic containers and drums most often; 'potte' is not named specifically, but the list is open ('ander groot houers') and nothing contradicts it.

items.bewering: Die San het al lank gelede water in volstruiseierdoppe gestoor.
items.bron: Lam Museum, Wake Forest University, 'San ostrich egg canteen': 'Having a method to store water is incredibly important in the desert, and ostrich eggs provide a means to accomplish that.' Diepkloof Rock Shelter (Western Cape): engraved ostrich eggshell water containers about 60 000 years old (Texier et al., PNAS 2010, via Wikipedia). Morris 1994, South African Archaeological Bulletin: a Later Stone Age cache of eggshell containers at Vaalbos (journals.uj.ac.za). 'lank gelede' is open-ended and holds for both the ethnographic and the archaeological record.

items.bewering: Hulle het die doppe in die grond begrawe om die water vir later te bewaar.
items.bron: Lam Museum, Wake Forest University: 'The filled eggs are buried along frequently traveled paths to provide drinking water while hunting and foraging.' Morris 1994 (South African Archaeological Bulletin): fifteen ostrich eggshell containers found packed together in the Kalahari sand at Vaalbos, read as a Khoisan cache.

items.bewering: 'n Dorp en die omliggende plase kry dikwels water uit dieselfde dam.
items.blok: Een dam vir die boer en die dorp
items.bron: NPR, 4 Feb 2018: Theewaterskloof serves the city and local farmers, and Elandskloof Dam is part of 'a network of dams that farmers, villages and the City of Cape Town share'. Metz Dam: domestic supply plus irrigation. The planned Zalu Dam will supply domestic water and irrigation to Lusikisiki and surrounding villages (Engineering News, 26 Sep 2025).

items.bewering: In 'n droogte word daardie water minder.
items.blok: Een dam vir die boer en die dorp
items.bron: NPR, 4 Feb 2018: Theewaterskloof was at 13% during the drought, and Elandskloof was a third full, so a farmer's allocation was cut to 17%. DWS briefing 2015: drought caused shortages in supply schemes and dams.

items.bewering: Die boer se gewasse en diere het water nodig. Wat hy verbou, is kos vir ander mense.
items.blok: Een dam vir die boer en die dorp
items.bron: NPR, 4 Feb 2018: fruit growers lost crops when irrigation was cut. The IntechOpen farm-dam chapter: dams serve irrigation and livestock. It is read as a statement about this scenario's farmer, not about every crop grown in SA.

items.bewering: Die dorpsbewoner se gesin het elke dag water nodig om te drink, te kook en te was.
items.blok: Een dam vir die boer en die dorp
items.bron: Free Basic Water's daily minimum of 25 litres per person, and the WHO's minimum of 20 litres per person per day for basic needs (The Conversation, 2025; hhrjournal.org).

items.bewering: Daarom maak goeie waterbestuur saak: mense stoor water vooruit en gebruik dit versigtig. Dit help hulle om 'n droogte beter deur te kom.
items.blok: Een dam vir die boer en die dorp
items.bron: DWS 2015 briefing: storage gives 'higher assurance of supply', and the briefing calls for 'pro-active and responsive risk management'. DWS media statement, 13 Jan 2021 (gov.za): it urges people to keep conserving water because the country 'is not out of the woods yet'.

items.bewering: Die tabel en staafgrafiek is 'n voorbeeld van 'n opgemaakte dam. Mense gebruik elke maand water uit die dam, maar daar val te min reën. ... In hierdie voorbeeld het die dam van maand tot maand minder water.
items.blok: 'n Voorbeeld: hoe vol die dam is
items.bron: This is a made-up example and is labelled as one, so it was checked for internal consistency and physical plausibility. When more water is used than flows in, the stored volume falls, as with the real Theewaterskloof decline to 13% (NPR 2018). The list (vol, driekwart, halfvol, 'n kwart) falls by the same step each month, which matches 'van maand tot maand minder water'. Note: the dam is still 'vol' at the end of month one despite use and too little rain. That is possible if it began the month overflowing, and it is not a factual error, but a person may want to know it is there.

items.bewering: Elke staaf staan vir een maand, en sy hoogte wys hoe vol die dam aan die einde daarvan is.
items.blok: 'n Voorbeeld: hoe vol die dam is
items.bron: Mapping checked. One bar per category (month) is the standard bar-graph convention, and height in proportion to the value (fullness) is standard too (Mathwords, 'bar graph'; LibreTexts 6.05 'Bar Graphs'). A learner reasoning further, for example that a taller bar means more water, would reach the right conclusion. The only risk is reading a bar as volume rather than as a fraction of full, and both readings agree here because it is one dam.

items.bewering: Dit word al hoe moeiliker om genoeg vir die boer en die dorp te hê.
items.blok: 'n Voorbeeld: hoe vol die dam is
items.bron: NPR, 4 Feb 2018: as Elandskloof and Theewaterskloof fell, farmers' allocations shrank, and the city imposed restrictions (Wikipedia, Cape Town water crisis).

items.bewering: Eerste maand: vol; Tweede maand: driekwart vol; Derde maand: halfvol; Vierde maand: 'n kwart vol
items.blok: Maand en hoe vol die dam is
items.bron: Made-up figures, labelled as such in the block before. Checked for internal consistency: 1, 3/4, 1/2, 1/4 is a steady fall that matches the study text, and 'driekwart', 'halfvol' and ''n kwart' are correct fractions in that order.

items.bewering: opgaar: Om iets soos water te stoor sodat dit later gebruik kan word.
items.bron: Same basis as the item in 'Water vir later': the Dutch source word 'opgaren' means vergaren, verzamelen, sparen (woorden.org, citing Encyclo.nl). No Afrikaans dictionary entry could be reached online.

items.bewering: watertenk: 'n Groot houer waarin water gestoor word, dikwels reënwater van 'n dak af.
items.bron: City of Cape Town, 'Opvang van reënwater': typical tank sizes run from 1 500 l to 2 500 l and 5 000 l, and roof water flows to them through gutters and downpipes. 'dikwels' rightly leaves room for tanks filled from boreholes or the mains (DWS 2015 lists rainwater tanks among stand-alone supplies).

items.bewering: staafgrafiek: 'n Grafiek met stawe, waarin 'n langer staaf meer van iets wys.
items.bron: Mathwords, 'bar graph': the length or height of each bar stands for a value. Unacademy and LibreTexts: the longer the bar, the larger the value, and bars may be horizontal or vertical. 'langer' is therefore the right general word, and the lesson's 'hoogte' for its vertical example agrees with it.

opsomming: Every claim in all twelve blocks was checked against sources and none is false or unsettled; the lesson has no superlatives, the bar-graph mapping holds, and the only soft spots are that the meaning of 'opgaar' rests on its Dutch source word because no Afrikaans dictionary could be reached online, and that the made-up dam is still full at the end of month one despite use and too little rain, which is possible but not explained.
